name: alberto-orders-load-tests
description: K6 load tests for Alberto Order Service GraphQL API

scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && k6 run dist/smoke.test.js
scripts.test:load: npm run build && k6 run dist/load.test.js
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && k6 run dist/stress.test.js
scripts.test:spike: npm run build && k6 run dist/spike.test.js
scripts.test:local: npm run build && k6 run --env ENV=local dist/load.test.js
scripts.test:docker: npm run build && k6 run --env ENV=docker dist/load.test.js
scripts.test:consistency: npm run build && k6 run dist/consistency.test.js
scripts.test:throughput: npm run build && k6 run dist/throughput.test.js
scripts.test:throughput:burst: npm run build && k6 run --env SCENARIO=burst dist/throughput.test.js
scripts.test:throughput:extended: npm run build && k6 run --env SCENARIO=extended dist/throughput.test.js
scripts.test:throughput:skip-seed: npm run build && k6 run --env SKIP_SEEDING=true dist/throughput.test.js
scripts.test:throughput:quick-seed: npm run build && k6 run --env SEED_ITERATIONS=1000 --env SEED_MAX_DURATION=5m dist/throughput.test.js
